g.text: Launch Manager activates its initial Run Target "Minimal", which requires StateManager.
StateManager depends on setup_filesystems.sh, so it is started first.
The transition to Run Target "Minimal" is still ongoing, no Run Target is active yet.
Invoke callback: Run Target "Minimal" successfully activated due to Initial Startup
The transition to Run Target "Minimal" has finished, and it is now the active Run Target.
